summary: Fortis Inc. filed a Form 6-K (report of foreign private issuer) on July 2, 2026, announcing a teleconference and webcast scheduled for July 31, 2026, to discuss second quarter 2026 financial results. The press release provides dial-in details, registration information, and replay access. No special-situation corporate event—such as an acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private transaction, capital return, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC transaction, or abrupt management change—is disclosed. The filing is a routine earnings announcement. Regulatory clock and deal mechanics are not applicable.
